response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.rel_gap AS relative_gap, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM inv, overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
